summary: Approved. Release threat model is versioned (2026-03-05), includes explicit mitigation status per threat, and codifies release-blocking policy for high-risk findings. Abuse and jailbreak scenarios are mapped to executable regressions in docs/security/ABUSE_REGRESSION_MAPPING.md and enforced via scripts/ci/run-abuse-regression.sh with machine-readable output (ABUSE_REGRESSION_REPORT_JSON).
